name: dsh-at-sider
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: gives the native right-sidebar file tree six things — an @ file reference button (@文件 / @file, @文件夹 / @folder) on every row, a modification-time and a size column, sortable rows, a whole-workspace quick search & locate (with reveal-in-tree and one-click @ from file previews), a bottom git bar (branch, ahead/behind, expandable recent commits, multi-repo switcher, per-file state dots), and full keyboard navigation with tree semantics — by taking over the builtin `files` tab kind as an extension, with a runtime toggle back to the native tree. The Host half serves directory listings with mtimeMs and the git state over its own authenticated /api routes (the Harness's workspaceFiles listing carries no time); the Client half renders the tree with labelled @ chips that insert references into the composer (Alt-click copies the mention) and a pinned date column with a full local-time tooltip.
author: Chengrui Wang
